titles.en: Stele of Cuan Longyan, original stone

productionDate.eraLabel: 南朝宋孝武帝大明二年

dimensions.note: Figures as given by the provincial culture department page; they were not measured in this pass.

currentCollection.note: The stone is recorded at 薛官堡 in 陆良, inside a protective building raised for it in 1827. The cited pages do not state whether that building is the one now standing.
currentCollection.noteZh: 此碑记在陆良薛官堡，1827 年为其建保护建筑。所引页面未说明现存建筑是否即当年所建。

provenanceEvents.placeWording: 贞元堡（今薛官堡）斗阁寺
provenanceEvents.summary: A local official built a single-eave hall over the stone on the order of the provincial governor, to protect it.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 云贵总督命陆良知州在斗阁寺内建单檐硬山顶建筑，专为护碑。

review.note: Draft object record. Dimensions and the 1827 event come from a provincial page read on 2026-11-18; the stone was not examined and the present shelter is unconfirmed.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录。尺寸与 1827 年一事取自 2026-11-18 阅读的省级页面；未核对原石，现存保护建筑未确认。

notes: The character count (1217 across both faces) comes from the provincial page; no rubbing was consulted.
The location is recorded as an in-situ claim at village scale, not as a surveyed point.
Later literature names a writer; the cited pages do not, so no hand is asserted.
notesZh: 两面合计 1217 字取自省文旅厅页面；未核对拓本。
方位按「原址」记在村落尺度，不是实测点位。
后世文献称有撰文者，所引页面未载，故不主张作者。
